property.name: subtitle
property.value: Timed stones, collapsing catwalks and swinging gears

property.name: text
property.value: The workshop runs in sunlight. Stones switch with the water clock. Listen for three warning ticks.

property.name: text
property.value: Crumbling slabs fall after you step on them. Keep moving! The lower floor is safe.

property.name: text
property.value: Cross the broken service catwalk or take the pendulums above it.

property.name: text
property.value: The drum reaches the turning gear. Ride a seat to the manuscript balcony.
